auth_heading: Take a step back. At your own pace.
auth_intro: Log your cigarettes, follow your habits and keep track of your spending.
password_help: At least 12 characters to create an account.
heading: Every cigarette counts.
price_at_entry: At the price of each entry
empty_day_note: A day without entries does not necessarily mean no smoking.
forgot_entry: Missed an entry? Add it here.
search_timezone: Search by city, country or IANA identifier
price_note: The price and currency apply to new entries, including past consumption. Previous amounts keep their original currency; no exchange conversion is applied.
currency_price_hint: Enter the pack price in {0}. This does not convert the previous price.
api_note: A key grants access to your account. Use a dedicated key for Stream Deck. It expires after one year.
copy_key: Copy this key now: it will not be displayed again.
pending_entry: An entry is still unconfirmed. Retry the same action before adding another.
network_error: Unable to reach the server. Check your connection and retry.
server_address_error: Use an http(s) origin without a path or credentials.
android_https: The release app requires HTTPS. Debug builds accept HTTP for local network testing.
local_datetime: Local date and time: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm
entry_zone_note: Time zone: {0}. The current price will apply.
web_integrations: API keys and CSV export are available in the web interface.
invalid_integer: {0} must be an integer between {1} and {2}.
rate_limit: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
invalid_username: Username: 3–40 ASCII letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores.
username_taken: This username is already in use.
invalid_timezone: Select a time zone from the IANA catalog.
invalid_price: Enter a price from 0 to 1,000,000, with at most {0} decimal places for {1}.
price_required: Enter a new pack price when changing currency.
invalid_period: Select a past or current period of 1–366 days.
invalid_timestamp: Use an ISO 8601 date with a time zone.
invalid_entry_date: The date must be between 2000 and now.
initial_timezone: Initial time zone detected: {0}. You can change it in your preferences.
analysis_basis: Averages include every calendar day in the selected period, including days with no entries.
day_in_progress: Today is still in progress; comparisons are provisional.
analysis_range: Daily range: {0}–{1} cigarettes · {2} days with entries
widget_pin_help: Long-press your home screen, choose Widgets, then SuuLess.
push_unavailable: Widget push is not configured on this server.
push_invalid_endpoint: Choose the ntfy server shown in the app, then enable synchronization again.
push_limit: Too many registered push sessions. Revoke unused sessions first.
push_registration_failed: Widget synchronization failed. Check ntfy and enable it again.
push_setup: Synchronization uses your SuuLess account automatically. Allow notifications and unrestricted battery use to keep the widget updated while the screen is off. A persistent notification lets you stop synchronization at any time.
sync_notification_body: Keeping your home-screen counter up to date
chart_accessibility: Daily chart. Tap a day, use the day buttons or open daily figures to explore the values.
preferences_intro: Make this space yours. Preferences are shared across your devices.
habits_note: Recorded quantities in {0}. Grouped entries count at their recorded time. Today is incomplete; repeated DST hours are combined.
weekday_note: Average per calendar occurrence of each weekday, including days with no entries.
projection_note: Estimate from {0} completed calendar days in the selected period, including days with no entries. Today is excluded. This is not a forecast or a currency conversion.
projection_empty: Select a period with at least one completed day to see an estimate.
habits_empty: No cigarettes recorded in this period.
trend_note: Trailing 7-day average, limited to the selected period. The first points use fewer days; today remains provisional.
history_wait: {0} days of history since the first recorded cigarette. The 30- and 90-day views unlock at their respective thresholds.
plan_conflict: Your plan changed on another device. Refresh before saving.
baseline_note: Choose 1–90 completed days with recorded consumption. The reference stays fixed; days without entries count as zero.
baseline_exists: A fixed reference has already been saved.
baseline_empty: Record consumption in this period before using it as a reference.
progress_value: {0} fewer cigarettes than the reference · {1}% reduction · {2} confirmed days
progress_missing: Save a reference and confirm completed days after it to measure progress.
progress_money_note: Estimated spending avoided against the fixed reference, on confirmed days only. Negative values mean an increase. Currencies are not converted; no estimate is shown when they are incompatible.
quit_clock: Since the declared quit date or last recorded cigarette: {0} days, {1} hours
setback_note: One cigarette does not erase your progress. Your confirmed days and urges overcome stay recorded.
craving_conflict: This urge was already resolved on another device. Refresh.
checkin_note: Check for missing entries before confirming. Today is provisional. Only completed, confirmed zero-cigarette days count as tobacco-free. Adding or deleting an entry reopens the affected day.
checkin_conflict: The count changed. Refresh and check before confirming.
reminder_note: Times use your account timezone. Android reminders require notification permission and can be delayed by battery management. The web shows reminders while open.
reminder_quiet_conflict: Choose reminder times outside quiet hours.
daily_reminder_message: Take a moment to check yesterday’s entries.
support_note: These resources can help you find professional support and discuss cessation options.
report_note: The report includes recorded quantities, confirmations, chosen goals and historical costs. Share it yourself with the person you choose.
progress_increase: {0} more cigarettes than the reference · {1}% increase over {2} confirmed days.
today_intro: A moment to check in. Record a cigarette or take a pause when you feel an urge.
journey_intro: Set your own pace, follow your progress and adjust your goals.
analysis_intro: Understand your consumption, spending and habits over time.
history_intro: Review your entries, add a missing one or correct a mistake.
settings_intro: Your preferences and connections, in one place.
sessions_note: Each sign-in creates a session. Web: 24 hours; Android: 30 days. Only unexpired access is shown. Times use your selected time zone.
revoke_other_confirm: Sign out all other sessions? Your current access and API keys will remain valid.
other_sessions_revoked: Other sessions have been signed out.
legacy_access_note: These older entries do not record their type. They may be sessions or API keys named “Session”. Revoke them individually if no longer needed; they are excluded from bulk sign-out.
account_delete_note: This permanently deletes your account, consumption history, preferences, journey, cravings, confirmations, API keys and sessions. This cannot be undone.
account_delete_confirm: I understand that my account and its data will be permanently deleted.
account_delete_invalid: Enter your current password and confirm the permanent deletion.
account_deleted: Your account and its data have been deleted.
disable_confirm: Disable this user and sign out all their devices?
invitations_note: Invitations expire after 48 hours. Sending a new invitation replaces the previous link.
smtp_password_note: Leave the password blank to keep it. Select “Clear password” to remove it.
smtp_note: When enabled, new public registrations require email activation. Existing accounts remain accessible. Save before testing.
mail_sent: Accepted by the SMTP server. Inbox delivery is not confirmed; check spam and the sender’s delivery reports.
email_requested: If this address is eligible, an email will be sent. Check your inbox and spam folder.
account_link_completed: Done. You can now sign in.
invalid_account_link: This link is invalid, expired or already used. Request a new email.
user_space_only: Use the administration area with this account.
admin_protected: Administrator accounts cannot be disabled or deleted here.
activation_required: The email address must be verified first.
email_taken: This email address is already in use.
mail_unavailable: Account email delivery is not configured.
mail_failed: Email delivery failed. Check the SMTP configuration and try again.
email_note: Verify your email to enable password recovery. Enter your current password to change it.
admin_browser: Open administration in your browser and sign in there.
smtp_environment_managed: SMTP is managed by environment variables. Update them and restart the service to change this configuration.
report_description: Personal record of logged cigarette consumption, for discussion with a tobacco cessation specialist. No name or account identifier is included.
report_limits: Averages include all calendar days in the selected period. No entry does not mean no smoking. Costs use historical prices, with currencies kept separate. This self-reported record is not a medical assessment.
report_print_help: Open this HTML file in a browser to print it or save it as PDF.
export_note: Choose a file to download or share. Only the selected period is included. The shared file contains personal consumption data.
share_unavailable: Sharing is unavailable here. Download the file and attach it in your preferred application.
export_choose_period: Choose the last 7, 30 or 90 days, including today in your account time zone.
